targets.rawSql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM field_submissions WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY status
SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (reviewed_at - created_at)) / 3600) as hours FROM field_submissions WHERE reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) as time, COUNT(*) as count FROM field_submissions WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
